propositions: On exhausted structured-parse retries in _pai_structured's prompted branch, write one timestamped artifact to llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir containing raw reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count before raising the final error.

The new llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir config key is added to LLMConfig in src/rebar/llm/config.py, resolved via _llm_str with REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR env alias and None default (opt-in, no behavior change when unset).
Artifact write is best-effort and local; any I/O error is swallowed and the original parse error is raised unchanged, ensuring the debugging aid never masks the actual failure.
The artifact directory is auto-created if absent and old artifacts are pruned by mtime to retain at most 20, preventing unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
Successful parses bypass the failure hook and write no artifact; the write occurs only when retries are exhausted in the prompted branch before the terminal raise.
